knownLimits: File backend is for isolated development; crash-held publication locks require explicit recovery. PostgreSQL adapter is not yet integration-verified.
Snapshot records currently preserve full captured body/evidence payloads; volume and retention performance must be verified before production.
Scheduler capture is opt-in and not enabled in the preview; normal collection is disabled.
Existing source publication carries a researchPublication marker only when capture is enabled. Archive failures defer completion; uncertain commits require review rather than overwriting source data.
Archive evidence currently supports topic, source and Beijing publication-date filters; country roles are not yet available and country selection returns an explicit unsupported-scope notice.
Archive replay response currently includes classification summaries for the full filtered set; server pagination and large-volume payload validation remain pending.

Real paid isolated 50-document Qwen historical backtests now run with explicit user authorization. Production model calls still require unified admission; no automatic paid production worker is enabled.
Exact quotations, numerical support and schema validation do not establish semantic truth or causal validity. Fact aggregation and real research-output acceptance remain pending.
PostgreSQL product/runtime migration is provided but not applied or integration-verified. Local file locks are never silently stolen; unresolved calls retain quota and require reconciliation.

Object registration preserves source identities but does not resolve legacy homonyms already conflated upstream. Cross-report event identity and country/date semantics need further evidence and review.
Object list is server-paginated; dossier facts and relation histories are currently read as one payload and need production-volume pagination.
Three domains have locally published model-reviewed historical briefs; two domains failed validation and one has insufficient source material. No expert or human review is claimed.
PostgreSQL validation used an isolated local database and synthetic record reads; production scale, full API performance and whole-library preservation remain pending.
Country multi-selection currently scopes the dossier only; global map and shared navigation integration remains pending.

Dossier generation/review/publication and historical revisions are implemented. Automatic draft attempts failed validation; one edited object stage and one edited Norway project observation passed paid model review locally. Comprehensive industrial and country assessments are not complete.

nextIteration.title: 4. 整页性能及最终验收
nextIteration.work: 在最终部署规格的隔离环境执行1万/10万篇、20只读会话、每场景至少100次的冷/热缓存整页测试；不足则优化摘要索引、分页、按需加载及版本缓存。
nextIteration.acceptance: 点击反馈P95≤200ms、缓存首屏P95≤1s、未缓存普通首屏P95≤3s；报告网络、资源、失败率；生产原库不注入测试数据。

prototypeGaps.done: F01职责链、F02三类成果、F03六领域、F04六业务入口顺序已实现。 三类成果状态现读取真实发布清单，并链接到已保存成果。
prototypeGaps.remaining: 继续完善历史版本与范围导航；全库成果覆盖仍取决于回填，不能把样本成果称为全部完成。

prototypeGaps.done: 四阶段回放、批次和累计统计、六领域简报、清单与版本证据联动已搭建。 六个入口始终可见，紧凑卡片+正文预览及固定版本引用已核验；已修复独立组件样式与预览栏宽度。
prototypeGaps.remaining: 全库真实处理批次、上游任务同步与可恢复90天回填；扩大成果背景资料覆盖并核验范围恢复。

prototypeGaps.done: F01过程、F02筛选与补充、F03范围/对象摘要、F04对象框架和档案顺序已实现。
prototypeGaps.remaining: 补齐类型字段实际证据、行业阶段配置、跨报道事件归并、广泛对象研判；完善身份合并与异议校准入口、附件/OCR及跨存储确认事务。

prototypeGaps.done: 地图上移；国别档案、阶段主题、关系研判顺序已搭建，原报道和趋势保留。 完整地图国家字典、上方搜索复选、聚焦与选择分离、URL恢复、多国档案分别切换及主题10/20条浏览已实现。
prototypeGaps.remaining: 真实国家角色、类型关系、语义主题归并、7/30天比较及研判演变；旧版报道趋势与新档案范围最终统一。

prototypeGaps.done: 版本引用、失败拦截、局部浏览器验收和隔离PG事务验证已有结果。
prototypeGaps.remaining: 统一成果上标引用/异议状态/修订原因；全量数据保护、90天分析回填、最终规格整页性能；按原型区域顺序、主次关系逐页截图验收。
